lmcache.why_source: prebuilt wheels lack the optional lmcache.lmcache_mooncake extension that the mooncake_store L2 adapter needs (Mooncake docs, vllmv1-lmcache-mp-integration.md)

mooncake.why_wheel_variant: default wheel targets CUDA 12.1-12.9; cuda13 variant for CUDA 13.x (quick-start.md); LMCache v0.5.7 and vLLM 0.33.0 install cu13 torch

vllm_e2.why: src/compute/vllm (xdev_tp_vllm) accepts exactly vLLM 0.10.2; all three E2 arms use it

ray.why: vLLM 0.10.2 requirements/cuda.txt: ray[cgraph]>=2.48.0; docs/serving/parallelism_scaling.md: multi-node vLLM deployments require Ray
